notes: FormSG is a manual webhook DPG — form creators paste a webhook URL into the form's settings UI. On each submission, FormSG sends an end-to-end encrypted POST signed with `X-FormSG-Signature` (ed25519). The subscriber must use `@opengovsg/formsg-sdk` (or its decryption logic) with the form's secret key to verify the signature, decrypt the payload, and resolve attachment download links. FormSG has no programmable subscription API — every form is set up by hand.

triggers.name: New Form Submission
triggers.description: Fires when a respondent submits a form. The form creator pastes the OpenFn webhook URL into the form's settings. The POST body contains the form ID, submission ID and an encrypted payload; verify `X-FormSG-Signature` (ed25519 over timestamp+submissionId+formId) and decrypt with the form's secret key via the FormSG SDK to recover the actual field values.
triggers.mechanismDetail: Manual webhook (E2E encrypted, FormSG SDK required to decrypt)

triggers.name: New Payment Submission
triggers.description: Fires when a respondent submits a form that includes Stripe payment fields. FormSG has Stripe integration but it is unclear from the docs whether payment-bearing submissions fire a distinct webhook event vs. arriving as part of the standard submission payload with payment fields populated. Fallback: subscribe to `New Form Submission` and branch on the presence of payment fields in the decrypted payload.

output.summary: FormSG submission with embedded payment intent / receipt fields
